title: Unify full Hybrid and Software engine assets

definition.hypothesis: One full engine with selectable browser/software decoding eliminates duplicate engine transfer and compilation with a small presentation adapter change.
definition.baseline: Frozen screen-01 runtime and full-study-02 matched full engines.
definition.success_criteria: At least 40 percent combined engine gzip saving; at least 25 percent prepare-all median reduction; no more than 5 percent growth above larger individual binary; correctness required.
definition.stop_criteria: Wrong output, lost fallback, or no quiet browser timing interval.
definition.primary_metric: Unique engine transfer bytes, preparation and selection-to-progress time, fallback time.
definition.negative_control: Independent inverted picture; explicit Software must not activate browser decoding.
definition.effort_limit: One unified binary and bounded browser matrix; codec modules deferred.

define.basis: Predeclared shared binary, fixed mode per instance, correctness and paired timing contract.

prepare.basis: Matched immutable baseline builds and runtime; native source and fixture generation captured.

screen.basis: Unified full engine built with one mode-dependent VO patch; no FFmpeg changes.

correctness.basis: H264/HEVC core profiles and verified rotation pass in Chrome Hybrid/Software and Firefox Software; independent oracle, matched baseline, fallback and teardown. Cache concurrency and cancellation controls pass.

performance.basis: Unified full engine shares download/compilation with 49.43 percent combined gzip savings and qualified bounded playback; paired preparation/recovery timings completed.

results.basis: Unified full engine shares download/compilation with 49.43 percent combined gzip savings and qualified bounded playback; paired preparation/recovery timings completed.

decision.basis: Unified full engine shares download/compilation with 49.43 percent combined gzip savings and qualified bounded playback; paired preparation/recovery timings completed.

record.reason: Unified full engine shares download/compilation with 49.43 percent combined gzip savings and qualified bounded playback; paired preparation/recovery timings completed.
record.evidence_level: actual-route correctness and binary-size measurement with paired timing

integration.scope: Shipping runtime; lab integration implemented in run/runtime.

next_action: Port the unified engine/cache to maintained source with streaming fetch/compile overlap, remeasure cold startup, and qualify packaging; codec modules remain deferred.
